answer: Before the first payout, the holder whispers a short sonnet into the microphone, and only a salted hash of the voiceprint is stored. Two verifiers compare it against other accounts' voiceprints within a day, and that voiceprint anchors the account to one real person. The same voiceprint on two accounts closes both at once. An honest user spends a minute whispering once, while 1,000 fakes would need 1,000 different voices, each whispering its own sonnet.
